# Web{X} Studio

> Web{X} Studio is an international web design, development and SEO agency based in Ludhiana, India, building high-converting landing pages, websites and search-optimised digital products for founders and brands across India and worldwide.

Web{X} Studio (https://www.thewebxstudio.com) delivers website design, web development, SEO & performance, ERP & web apps, and pixel-perfect Figma-to-code conversion (Webflow, WordPress, Shopify, Framer, Unbounce). Design, engineering and motion under one roof. The studio serves founders and brands in India, the UK, the US and the Gulf. Contact: hello@thewebxstudio.com.

## Services offered
Web{X} Studio provides these services to clients worldwide:
- **UX/UI design** — user experience and interface design, wireframing, prototyping, design systems
- **Branding and brand identity** — logo, visual identity, brand guidelines, graphic design
- **Responsive web design** — mobile-first layouts that work across every screen size
- **Web development** — Webflow, WordPress, Shopify, Framer, Unbounce, and fully custom builds
- **E-commerce development** — Shopify storefronts, Online Store 2.0 sections, custom checkout flows
- **Conversion rate optimisation (CRO)** — landing page optimisation, funnel design, A/B-ready builds
- **Technical SEO and performance** — Core Web Vitals, structured data, site speed, SEO migrations
- **Answer engine optimisation (AEO)** — content and schema structured for AI search and citation
- **WCAG accessibility** — accessible markup, contrast and keyboard navigation built in, not bolted on
- **Digital marketing** — campaigns, analytics and acquisition funnels
- **ERP systems and B2B SaaS platforms** — dashboards, internal tools, custom business software
- **Mobile web apps** — installable, responsive applications
- **Figma to code conversion** — pixel-perfect handoff to Webflow, WordPress, Shopify, Framer or Unbounce

## Markets served
Web{X} Studio works remotely with founders and brands in:
- India (headquartered in Ludhiana, Punjab)
- United Kingdom
- United States
- United Arab Emirates and the wider Gulf
- Australia and Canada

Engagements run async across time zones with scheduled milestones and written updates.

## Common questions
**What does Web{X} Studio do?**
It is an international web design, development and SEO agency. It designs and builds websites, landing pages, e-commerce stores, ERP systems and B2B SaaS platforms, and handles branding, UX/UI design, technical SEO and conversion optimisation for each.

**Where is Web{X} Studio based, and who does it work with?**
The studio is headquartered in Ludhiana, Punjab, India, and works remotely with clients in the UK, the US, the Gulf, Australia and Canada as well as across India.

**What platforms does the studio build on?**
Webflow, WordPress, Shopify, Framer and Unbounce, plus fully custom builds in React, Next.js, Vue, Node and Python when a project needs them.

**How much does a project cost?**
Pricing is not published. Cost is driven by page count, CMS structure, how much animation and interaction the design calls for, and any third-party integrations. Every project is quoted as one fixed, itemised number after a short scoping call.

**How long does a project take?**
A focused landing page takes roughly 2-3 weeks. A full website design and development project usually runs 5-10 weeks across discovery, design, build and launch, depending on content readiness and revision rounds.

**Does the studio handle accessibility?**
Yes. Builds follow WCAG guidance — semantic markup, keyboard navigation, and colour contrast checked as part of the work rather than audited afterwards.

**How do I start a project?**
Email hello@thewebxstudio.com or use the contact form at https://www.thewebxstudio.com/contact. Every enquiry gets a reply within two business days.
